name: cowart
description: A native fullscreen tldraw canvas for images, HTML, Slides and AI motion films. Open the canvas with Cowart MCP and reuse it for generation and playback.

interface.longDescription: Cowart brings a native tldraw canvas into Codex for visual planning and creative iteration. Open Cowart from global navigation and pin it with the host pin control. The sidebar opens a single canvas in the system Documents/Cowart folder, creating the first page when needed. Project conversations with projectDir keep their own project canvas. Image, HTML, Slides, AI film and annotation workflows reuse the open canvas.
defaultPrompt: Open the Cowart canvas for this project.
Use my Cowart annotation screenshot to generate a clean revised image beside the original.
Generate a new image into the selected Cowart AI image holder.
Generate an AI motion film into the selected Cowart film holder using cowart-film-gen.
